units.source_text: 夕雾闻此消息，想道：“果然不出所料，此人本性非常急躁。

en.t: When Yugiri heard this news, he thought, "It is just as I expected. This person is extremely hot-tempered by nature."

units.source_text: 她父亲也没有宽宏大量的气度，是个心直口快的人，说不定会骂道：‘岂有此理！

en.t: Her father, too, is not a man of broad and generous spirit, but one who speaks his mind bluntly, and he may well scold her, saying, "How outrageous!

units.source_text: 从此不再见他！

en.t: From now on, you must never see him again!

units.source_text: 从此不要说起他！

en.t: From now on, do not even speak of him!

units.source_text: ’而闹出奇奇怪怪的事情来。”

en.t: and then stir up all sorts of strange trouble."

units.source_text: 他心里害怕，立刻回三条院去。

en.t: Fearful at heart, he immediately returned to Sanjo Palace.

units.source_text: 但见几个男孩还留着，女孩和婴儿都被母亲带走了。

en.t: There he found that several boys were still there, but the girls and the baby had all been taken away by their mother.

units.source_text: 男孩们看见父亲回来，都很高兴，大家来亲近；

en.t: When the boys saw their father return, they were all delighted and came crowding close to him;

units.source_text: 有的想念母亲，向父亲诉苦哭泣。

en.t: some missed their mother and wept as they poured out their complaints to their father.

units.source_text: 夕雾心中非常难过。

en.t: Yugiri felt deeply distressed.

units.source_text: 他写了好几封信给云居雁，又派人去迎接，然而连回信也没有。

en.t: He wrote several letters to Kumoinokari and sent people to bring her back, but there was not even a reply.

units.source_text: 他大为不快，怪怨她何以如此轻率而又任性。

en.t: He was greatly displeased and blamed her for being so rash and willful.

units.source_text: 他深恐前太政大臣见怪，就在傍晚时分亲自去接。

en.t: Deeply afraid that the former Grand Minister would take offense, he went in person to fetch her at dusk.

units.source_text: 听说云居雁正在弘徽殿女御所居的正殿内。

en.t: He heard that Kumoinokari was in the main hall where the Kokiden Consort resided.

units.source_text: 夕雾便走进一向熟悉的房间里，但见只有几个侍女在内，婴儿跟着乳母也在这里。

en.t: Yugiri entered a room long familiar to him, only to find a few waiting women there; the baby was there too with its nurse.

units.source_text: 夕雾叫侍女向云居雁传言：“你现在还同年轻时候一样爱同姐妹们交际么？

en.t: Yugiri had a waiting woman convey a message to Kumoinokari: "Do you still enjoy keeping company with your sisters as you did when you were young?

units.source_text: 怎么可以把一群孩子东抛西舍，而自己到正殿里去闲玩呢？

en.t: How can you leave a whole group of children scattered about and go off to idle away your time in the main hall?

units.source_text: 多年来我早就知道你的性情和我不和，然而恐是因缘注定之故，我自昔就时刻不忘地恋慕你。

en.t: For many years I have known that your nature does not agree with mine, yet perhaps because fate bound us together, I have loved and yearned for you without forgetting you for a moment since long ago.

units.source_text: 现在已经有了这一群孩子，个个都很可爱，我俩已经互相信赖，不会再抛舍了。

en.t: Now we have this whole group of children, each one dear to us, and we have come to rely on each other, so surely we can no longer abandon one another.

units.source_text: 为了一点些些小事，难道你就如此决绝么？”

en.t: For the sake of one small matter, can you really be so final?"

units.source_text: 他严厉斥责，愤恨不已。

en.t: He rebuked her sternly, unable to contain his anger.

units.source_text: 云居雁叫侍女代答：“你已厌弃了我，认为毫不足取的了。

en.t: Kumoinokari had a waiting woman answer for her: "You have already grown tired of me and think me utterly worthless.

units.source_text: 现在我已不能改变性情，讨你喜欢。

en.t: At this point I cannot change my nature in order to please you.

units.source_text: 你又何必多言呢？

en.t: Why should you say anything more?

units.source_text: 但愿你不抛弃这些无知无识的孩子，照顾照顾他们，我就心满意足了。”

en.t: If only you do not abandon these innocent children and will look after them, I shall be fully content."

units.source_text: 夕雾说道：“好干脆的回答啊！

en.t: Yugiri said, "What a blunt reply!

units.source_text: 归根到底，是谁丢脸呢？”

en.t: In the end, who is it that will be disgraced?"

units.source_text: 便不强要她回去。

en.t: So he did not force her to go back with him.

units.source_text: 这一晚他就在那里独宿。

en.t: That night he slept there alone.

units.source_text: 自念此时弄得莫名其妙，两头落空，不胜懊丧，便叫几个孩子睡在身边，聊以自慰。

en.t: Thinking that everything had become bewilderingly confused and that he had failed on both sides, he was unbearably dejected, so he had several of the children sleep beside him for what little comfort they could give.

units.source_text: 推想落叶公主此时亦必十分恨他，心情不安，难于堪忍。

en.t: Imagining that Princess Ochiba must also be hating him greatly at that moment, troubled and unable to bear her feelings, he felt uneasy.

units.source_text: 他想：“世间怎么竟会有人把恋爱当作风流韵事呢？”

en.t: He thought, "How can there actually be people in this world who regard love affairs as elegant amusements?"

units.source_text: 便觉此事深可惩诫。

en.t: He felt that this affair should serve as a profound warning.

units.source_text: 天明之后，他又叫人向云居雁传言：“只管像小孩一样胡闹，教人听见了可笑。

en.t: After daybreak, he again sent someone to tell Kumoinokari, "If you go on making a childish fuss like this, people will hear of it and laugh.

units.source_text: 你既说过情缘已绝，我也就作如是想吧。

en.t: Since you have said that our bond is severed, I shall think of it that way as well.

units.source_text: 只是留在那边的几个孩子，正在可怜地想念你。

en.t: Only, the children left over there are pitifully missing you.

units.source_text: 你不选取那几个孩子，想必是有用意的。

en.t: You must have had some purpose in not choosing those children.

units.source_text: 但我舍不得他们，总要设法安排。”

en.t: But I cannot bear to part with them, so I must find some way to arrange matters."

units.source_text: 他用这话威吓她。

en.t: With these words he tried to frighten her.

units.source_text: 云居雁心念夕雾是个决决断断的人，说不定会把这几个孩子带到陌陌生生的一条院去，便担心起来。

en.t: Kumoinokari thought that Yugiri was a decisive man and might well take these children to the unfamiliar Ichijo Palace, and she began to worry.

units.source_text: 夕雾又说：“把几个女孩还给我吧。

en.t: Yugiri said again, "Give the girls back to me.

units.source_text: 我为了要看她们而特地来此，甚是不便。

en.t: It is very inconvenient for me to come all the way here specially just to see them.

units.source_text: 况且我又不能常来。

en.t: Besides, I cannot come often.

units.source_text: 那边的孩子也都很可爱，总得让他们同住在一处，以便照顾。”

en.t: The children over there are all dear as well, so they should be made to live together in one place where they can be cared for more easily."

units.source_text: 几个女孩年纪都还很小，十分可爱。

en.t: The girls were all still very young and extremely lovely.

units.source_text: 夕雾看了觉得非常可怜，对她们说：“你们不可听母亲的话！

en.t: Seeing them, Yugiri felt great pity and said to them, "You must not listen to your mother!

units.source_text: 如此倔强不通道理，是最可恶的！”

en.t: To be so stubborn and unreasonable is the most hateful thing of all!"
